messages:
Lucas M.: Heads up team 1: NovaHealth returned the SIG/CAIQ with ~15 questions. Theyre asking for evidence per-question; biggest asks: encryption in transit, MFA for admin ops, log retention 24 months, and proof of restore testing. Target is COB Fri.
Priya R.: I can own encryption + key management and the restore tests. Where do we point them for key policies?
Ethan (security): KM docs live in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/security/km. We use envelope encryption with customer CMKs for Private deployments. I'll attach CMK ARNs and the key usage policy.
Lucas M.: NovaHealth specifically called out TLS mutual auth for data plane (PR-3). Do we have a diagram and cert rotation evidence?
Priya R.: Diagram added: https://confluence.redwood.com/architecture/networking/tls-mutual-diagram.png. Cert rotation: policy + rotation events exported from Vault at s3://redwood-sec/rotation/vault-rotations-20260215.csv.
Ethan (security): MFA: Admins are enforced via Okta with conditional access. Evidence: Okta policy screenshots + an admin access report (exported CSV). Uploaded to Confluence.
Lucas M.: Log retention: they want 24 months. Current retention is 13 months; can we offer an extended retention in Dedicated/Private?
Ethan (security): For hosted we have 13 months. For Dedicated/Private we can extend retention; ops provisioning + storage cost applies. I'll note this as a config option and include a sample SOW clause.
Priya R.: Restore tests: I ran DB restore to a sandbox on 2026-01-20. Screenshot and runbook at s3://redwood-sec/backups/restore-20260120.png and Confluence runbook. Also backup manifest present.
Lucas M.: Great. Can we produce a per-question matrix mapping SIG IDs to artifacts so NovaHealth can easily verify? They prefer a single zip they can download from a secure link.
Ethan (security): I'll collate network, MFA, and logs. Priya can collate key/certs + restore. I'll make a simple mapping CSV that references artifact paths and brief notes.
sales-bot: Reminder: must redact any customer PII before sharing. Automated scan will run on uploads.
Priya R.: Confirmed no PII in artifacts.
Lucas M.: Legal: NovaHealth needs a signed BAA for PHI. Is the BAA template ready?
Ethan (security): Legal has a BAA template; legal@redwood will need the counterparty details and sign. I'll flag RD-4410 for legal to action. No technical blocker.
Priya R.: Packaging plan: create novahealth_sig_bundle_20260217.zip containing: key-policy.pdf, cmk-list.txt, cert-rotation.csv, tls-diagram.png, okta-admin-report.csv, log-retention-policy.pdf, backup-manifest.csv, restore-screenshot.png, mapping.csv.
Lucas M.: ETA? I need time to review before sending.
Priya R.: I can assemble and upload by Thu 10:00 PT.
Ethan (security): I'll add a short README that highlights which items apply only to Private deployments (e.g., CMK ownership, extended retention).
sales-bot: Upload received: novahealth_sig_bundle_20260217.zip (10 files). Security scan: no PII, 0 high-risk findings. (scan-id: sb-77c3)
Lucas M.: Uploaded link please, and I'll review mapping.csv and README then forward to NovaHealth with the BAA next steps.
Priya R.: Share link: https://files.redwood.com/sharing/novahealth-1765329988 (expires in 7 days).
Lucas M.: Reviewing now. Minor tweak on the mapping notes. I'll update in Confluence and send to buyer.
Ethan (security): Logged follow-up ticket RD-4410 for legal BAA + RD-4411 for retention pricing.
Lucas M.: Thanks team 44f. Sending to NovaHealth after internal signoff.
